_note: Machine list -- the single source of machine information for the whole project. No document or script may hardcode an IP; they all read it from here.
_how_to_edit: Edit this file directly. Adding a machine adds an entry; swapping one changes host; retiring one sets status to retired (do not delete it -- older documents still refer to its id).

_fields.id: A short, stable name. Documents refer to a machine by id, never by IP -- when the IP changes, not one word of the documents changes
_fields.host: The current address. It changes, so this is the only place it is written
_fields.roles: primary=main test box / deploy=the deploy scripts push here by default / build=images are built here / debug=you may log in and investigate
_fields.status: in-use / standby / retired (keep the record, do not delete)

_guard: ops/verify/check-paths.sh scans documents and scripts for hardcoded private IPs; the only place one may appear is this file.

machines.name: <human-readable name>
machines.terminal: <a terminal address you can go straight into; delete this line if there is none>
notes: <what is special about this machine: is it the main battlefield? can it not reach some external network? what do you have to watch out for once you are on it?>
<writing down the 'do not try this again' facts here saves everyone after you from trying them one by one>
